newsitem.title: UK: JWT's Colebrook extends role,Madel Europe presiden.
newsitem.headline: JWT's Colebrook extends role,Madel Europe presiden.

text.p: Miles Colebrook, president and chief executive of J Walter Thompson Europe, has been promoted to Group President International at JWT, the advertising agency said on Wednesday.
Colebrook is succeeded by Michael Madel, the chairman and chief executive officer of JWT Germany.
In his new role, Colebrook will have overall responsibility for Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific beginning January 1997.
JWT said Alan Fairnington (rpt Fairnington), president of JWT Asia Pacific, would continue in that role and would report to Colebrook.
JWT said the changes were announced by Chris Jones, CEO Designate of the J Walter Thompson Company. JWT is part of WPP Group Plc, the world's biggest advertising and marketing services group.
Jones said the changes were designed to refine the most senior management structure of the company.
JWT also announced that Peter Schweitzer, president of the J Walter Thompson Company and based in Detroit, would become responsible for North America and Latin America.
Ron Burns, currently president of JWT North America, relinquishes that role to assume the new position of President - Global Business.

Colebrook joined JWT London in 1966 as a media buyer and became an account executive in 1970. In 1986 he became managing director of JWT London and in 1987 he was appointed to the Worldwide Board. In 1989 he moved to become chief executive of JWT Europe. He is also a member of the JWT Worldwide Executive Group.
Madel has been with JWT for the past six years and before that was chairman and CEO of Bates Germany. In the last few years Madel was JWT's Area Director of Central and Eastern Europe.
